sources.title: tipsv2-b14: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview tipsv2-b14 is a contrastive vision-language model developed by google that produces spatially rich image features aligned with text embeddings. This Base variant contains 86M vision parameters and 110M text parameters, with an embedding dimension of 768, and uses a ViT vision encoder (12 layers) paired with a Transformer text encoder (12 layers). sources.title: tipsv2-b14 · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: TIPSv2 — B/14 TIPSv2 (Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness) is a family of contrastive vision-language models that produce spatially rich image features aligned with text embeddings. This is the Base variant with 86M vision params and 110M text params. Try the code snippets below or check out the GitHub repo for more use cases and visualizations, including zero-shot segmentation.
